2Unfold Bag
Regular price
$995.00 CAD

This is a demonstration store. You can purchase products like this from Hardgraft.

Your search is over. That is, if you've been looking for a slim, extremely versatile, timeless laptop bag which is carefully handmade with the finest materials. This bag is our tried and tested instant classic with all the bells and whistles.

We've crafted this multi-use leather laptop bag to be as versatile as possible, which is a good thing because you'll never want to be without it. Carry up to a 17” laptop and accessories as a vertical briefcase, shoulder bag, or backpack. Fold it in half into a messenger bag or folio and carry a 14” laptop and a few more items.

We meticulously designed every detail of its construction, ensuring every one of its 8 different combinations is functional and joyful. The veg-tan leather and wool shoulder strap is removable, and the bag is lined with a super soft melange grey wool.

Measurements: 36 x 50 x 6 cm (14" x 20” x 2.5”)

Color: Brown
